reviewer: Separate AI reviewer of root-authored Ashtpadi12 study prose

scope.sourceContext: All 84 source occurrences in Ashtpadi 12 were used in authorship of the separate line meanings; these study explanations were subsequently checked against that source.

findings.result: Study retains explicit birth/death and degradation language; selected commentary’s filth/conduct reading is attributed. No moral licence to demean another person is inferred.
Dependence on Divine capacity is retained with responsible conduct as an identified practical application.
Source-close true-language and Sahib Singh’s completeness reading are distinguished; no assertion that finite objects never change.

refinement.reason: Punjabi wording could sound like receiving praise; clarified the intended heart offering praise.
refinement.revisedEnglishClosing: After the examination of pride, the Ashtpadi ends in praise and a heart turned toward Naam.
refinement.revisedPunjabiClosing: ਹੰਕਾਰ ਦੀ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਮਗਰੋਂ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਦੇ ਅਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਵੱਲ ਮੁੜੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਮੁੱਕਦੀ ਹੈ।
